mapper.select: SELECT fba_shipment_id, amazon_shipment_id, carton_count, registered_by, registered_at FROM fba_box_label_plan WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND fba_shipment_id = #{shipment}
SELECT box_number FROM fba_registered_box WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND fba_shipment_id = #{shipment} ORDER BY box_number
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fba_box_label_plan(tenant_id, fba_shipment_id, amazon_shipment_id, carton_count, registered_by, registered_at) VALUES (#{tenant}, #{r.fbaShipmentId}, #{r.amazonShipmentId}, #{r.cartonCount}, #{r.registeredBy}, #{r.registeredAt}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
INSERT INTO fba_registered_box(tenant_id, box_number, fba_shipment_id) VALUES (#{tenant}, #{number}, #{shipment}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.update: UPDATE fba_shipment SET amazon_shipment_id = #{amazon}, carton_count = #{count}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenant} AND fba_shipment_id = #{shipment}
